name: bazar-dor
description: বাজার দর: Bangladeshi daily grocery price tracker built with Next.js, BetterAuth and MongoDB

paragraphs: বাংলাদেশের নিত্যপ্রয়োজনীয় পণ্যের দৈনিক বাজার দর এক নজরে দেখার একটি ওয়েবসাইট। A Bangladeshi daily grocery price tracker: see today's prices, which items rose or fell, and market-wise price details.
features: Live price ticker and product cards: a scrolling price strip, plus responsive cards showing emoji, unit, Bengali-digit price and a green/red/gray change badge.
Top risers and fallers: the home page highlights the 6 products whose prices rose the most and the 6 that fell the most today.
Category pages with sorting: filter by category and sort by price (low to high, high to low) using real numeric values, not Bengali text.
Authentication: sign up, sign in and sign out with BetterAuth, plus Google and GitHub social login, with toast messages for success and errors.
Protected product details: logged-in users see minimum, maximum and average prices plus a market-by-market price table.
